summary.text: Tom Weber is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 64, in office since January 2019, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He succeeded Barbara Wheeler in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Tom Weber assumed office in the Illinois House on January 9, 2019, succeeding Barbara Wheeler (R), and advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Appropriations-Health and Human Services, Child Care Accessibility & Early Childhood Education, Consumer Protection, Judiciary - Civil, Labor & Commerce, and Small Business, Technology Innovation, and Entrepreneurship committees.
Ballotpedia lists AJ Johnson (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
